title: PFC board clears merger with REC
theme: PFC board clears merger with REC
attentionJustification: Enforceable regulatory circular issued by RBI/SEBI/DICGC.

constituentArticles.title: PFC board clears merger with REC
constituentArticles.text: Power Finance Corporation approved merger with subsidiary REC Ltd. PFC had acquired 52.63% in REC in March 2019 for ₹14,500 crore. Registered as NBFC with RBI since 1990.
